seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION6 with touching neighbours [hazard,hit,wall] show mixed outcomes: gone x1, x,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the presence, type or relative position of a neighbouring object. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Frame-colour rule: 5 floor, f/8 walls, 10 blocks, 1 armed players, 9/11 inactive/active 2x2 markers centred in 4x4 cells.
A1/A2 move both blocks y-/+4, A3 apart/A4 together (mirrored); armed mode moves the active marker by 4; a move succeeds iff the dest 4x4 cell is all colour 5 (own cells excluded).
Click colour 9 = arm/switch marker (10->1), click 1 = disarm (1->10, 11->9), others and A5 are no-ops.
HUD: row 0 from the right and row 63 from the left, both width 3(a+1)//7; a is tracked by frame-equality continuity, fallback 0 if no bar else (7w+3)//3 (stateless 13/30).
The marker ACTION6 gone vs x,y hypothesis is extractor renaming only; level-end/win behaviour not observed.
